scope: Only two original upper balcony exposed horizontal undersides,87 original faces; no upper main roof underside, returns, columns, glazing or railings.
source_observation: Actually inspected official source-0.jpg at full resolution and contractor source-1.jpg. Official image clearly shows two pale soffit panel fields with seams and small recessed lights; broad dark shading is illumination, not black material. Contractor image confirms identity and two balcony geometry but is weaker underside color evidence.
inference: Original solid planar slabs omit panel seams, small recessed lights and exact recess depth. Mapping pale family to exposed whole original underside faces is simplified uniform-family inference, not per-pixel/per-vertex material matching. Light fixtures are not modeled/colored separately; do not imply photo texture or reconstructed lighting geometry.
conditions: Verify87 are whole coplanar domains, original4front faces unchanged, all other material indices unchanged.
